saudi_regions.name: Saudi Arabia
saudi_regions.info: Largest country in the Arabian Peninsula. Capital: Riyadh.

saudi_regions.name: Jordan
saudi_regions.info: North of Saudi Arabia. Capital: Amman.

saudi_regions.name: Iraq
saudi_regions.info: North of Saudi Arabia. Capital: Baghdad.

saudi_regions.name: Kuwait
saudi_regions.info: Small country north of Saudi Arabia on the Persian Gulf. Capital: Kuwait City.

saudi_regions.name: Qatar
saudi_regions.info: Peninsula east of Saudi Arabia. Capital: Doha.

saudi_regions.name: United Arab Emirates
saudi_regions.info: United Arab Emirates, east of Saudi Arabia. Capital: Abu Dhabi.

saudi_regions.name: Yemen
saudi_regions.info: South of Saudi Arabia. Capital: Sanaa.

saudi_regions.name: Oman
saudi_regions.info: Southeast of Saudi Arabia. Capital: Muscat.

drc_regions.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
drc_regions.info: Largest country in Sub-Saharan Africa. Capital: Kinshasa. Rich in minerals.

drc_regions.name: Uganda
drc_regions.info: East of DRC. Capital: Kampala. Known as "Pearl of Africa".

drc_regions.name: Rwanda
drc_regions.info: Small country east of DRC. Capital: Kigali. "Land of a Thousand Hills".

drc_regions.name: Burundi
drc_regions.info: Small country east of DRC. Capital: Gitega.

drc_regions.name: Tanzania
drc_regions.info: East of DRC. Capital: Dodoma. Home to Mount Kilimanjaro.

drc_regions.name: Republic of the Congo
drc_regions.info: West of DRC. Capital: Brazzaville. Also called Congo-Brazzaville.

drc_regions.name: South Sudan
drc_regions.info: North of DRC. Capital: Juba. World's newest country (2011).

drc_regions.name: Zambia
drc_regions.info: South of DRC. Capital: Lusaka. Home to Victoria Falls.
